instance_primary_color_hex.name: instance_primary_color_hex
instance_primary_color_hex.value: length("instance"."primary_color") in (4, 7) and substr("instance"."primary_color", 1, 1) = '#' and substr("instance"."primary_color", 2) not glob '*[^0-9A-Fa-f]*'

post_links_image.name: post_links_image
post_links_image.value: "post_links"."image" is null or ("post_links"."image" like 'https://%' and length("post_links"."image") <= 500)

profiles_username_rules.name: profiles_username_rules
profiles_username_rules.value: length("profiles"."username") between 3 and 15 and "profiles"."username" not glob '*[^a-z0-9_]*'

profiles_name_length.name: profiles_name_length
profiles_name_length.value: length("profiles"."first_name") between 1 and 50 and length("profiles"."last_name") between 1 and 50

reports_closed_fields.name: reports_closed_fields
reports_closed_fields.value: ("reports"."status" = 'closed') = ("reports"."outcome" is not null and "reports"."closed_at" is not null)
